description: In every PA-model, the specified list-length program adds one on a constructor.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listLength_cons_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (a c : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listLength.value
      ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value ![a, c]] =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listLength.value ![c])
